journeyStory.heading: One journey. One trusted standard.
journeyStory.intro: Not a marketplace. Not a brochure and a WhatsApp thread. A private concierge for how Sri Lanka moves — from the first landing to the last coastal road.
journeyStory.closingTitle: Across the entire journey — the same calm certainty.
journeyStory.closingBody: Uber and PickMe move you across a city. Tour operators sell a day. Q Pick holds the whole story: airport, stay, and island — under one trusted standard.

arrive.title: Arrive
arrive.moment: The island begins at the gate.
arrive.scene: Your flight lands. A verified Q Pick driver is already waiting — not a scramble on the curb, not a chain of messages. Your hotel knows you are on the way before the car leaves the airport road.
arrive.outcome: One handoff. From arrivals to the front desk.
arrive.imageAlt: Colombo coast and city lights at dusk — the journey after landing

stay.title: Stay
stay.moment: Every move stays quiet and clear.
stay.scene: A coast run, a dinner reservation, a morning meeting. You see the fare before you confirm. While you ride, the people who matter can follow — family, host, or villa manager — without calling twice.
stay.outcome: Transparent pricing. Live status. No marketplace noise.
stay.imageAlt: Southern Sri Lankan coastline with clear Indian Ocean water

explore.title: Explore
explore.scene: Tea country mist. Fort towns. A day with more than one stop. The same trusted driver, the right vehicle for the roads ahead, and an itinerary held with care — so the place stays the point, not the logistics.
explore.outcome: Ride and tourism. One continuous standard.
explore.imageAlt: Sigiriya Rock Fortress rising from the Sri Lankan jungle

yourJourneyRules.heading: Your Journey. Your Rules.
yourJourneyRules.manifesto: From the first welcome to the final hotel door — a continuous hospitality standard ordinary ride-hailing was never built to hold.
yourJourneyRules.positioningLead: This is not just another taxi app.
yourJourneyRules.positioningRest: This is Sri Lanka’s premium travel platform.
yourJourneyRules.trustBody: Q Pick is powered by ATCCA — one of Sri Lanka’s longest-established professional chauffeur associations — with decades of hospitality experience behind every welcome, every transfer, and every carefully held journey.
yourJourneyRules.continuumBody: A wider hospitality ecosystem is quietly taking shape — the same calm standard, extended.

airport.title: The island begins with a welcome.
airport.scene: Your flight lands. A verified Q Pick hospitality professional is already waiting — name board ready, baggage in hand, hotel route confirmed. Not a scramble on the curb. Not a marketplace bid. Simply the quiet certainty that your Sri Lanka journey has begun with care.

planning.label: Compose
planning.title: Write your Sri Lanka — exactly as you wish.
planning.scene: Unlike ordinary ride-hailing, Q Pick lets you shape a full island journey before a single mile begins. Choose your destinations. Choose how many days you travel. Choose your hotels. Choose your vehicle — Tuk Tuk, Sedan, SUV, Premium Van, Luxury Van, Mini Bus, or Coach. Then see an estimated budget before you confirm.

chauffeur.label: Company
chauffeur.title: Not drivers. Hospitality professionals.
chauffeur.scene: Every Q Pick chauffeur is a verified hospitality professional — trained for discretion, island roads, and the quiet ritual of welcome. When you wish, you may also request a local guide for temples, tea country, wildlife, or living heritage — in English, Sinhala, Tamil, or other languages where available.

explore.label: Discovery
explore.title: Where the island becomes the story.
explore.scene: Coast roads. Highland mist. Heritage cities. While you explore, live trip management keeps every transfer clear — and 24/7 support remains quietly available if the day shifts. Ordinary apps end when the ride ends. Q Pick stays with the journey.
details: Live trip management for the full arc of travel
explore.whisper: Logistics remain invisible. Place remains the point.

complete.title: The same calm certainty, to the last door.
complete.scene: The final hotel drop closes the loop — coordinated from the app, timed to your lobby, delivered with the same hospitality that met you at the airport. One continuous standard. From first welcome to last goodbye — something ordinary ride-hailing cannot hold.

about.title: Built for how Sri Lanka moves
about.description: Q Pick is the trusted private layer of movement across the island — with the calm of a luxury concierge and the reliability of a modern mobility network.
paragraphs: We exist because fragmented WhatsApp fleets and generic global apps both miss what travellers and residents actually need: certainty, hospitality, and respect for place.
Our design system, safety standard, and product surfaces — passenger, driver, and operations — share one language. Quiet technology. Human journeys.
